notes.title: About game release!
notes.notes:
Hello, we are so excited to finally share Bob's journey with the world!. About the game release... The game is finished and ready to be published. We are waiting for steam release approval and we are ready to go. Sorry about the wait. Game SHOULD be released on next friday. 
Make sure to hit that wishlist button!

Tomas Gonzalez - Game Director
